prose: Inner Whirled Episode 12 tackles one of the best kept secrets of the Bible: just why do translators call God and Jesus "LORD?" The answers may surprise you (or not), as Dylan and I reveal the evidence behind an ancient feudal system of governance far more ancient than the origins of the Catholic church. The many names of the Sun of God will never mystify you again after you take the journey with us through this epic, nearly four hours long expose on the curious mystery of Jehovah, the Kurios.
